rows.body_you: You may want the name, title, photo, or introduction you use to match who you are now. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 1st house of identity and self-expression, so the name, look, and role you present to other people may feel more important than usual. You may rewrite a bio, change your appearance, claim a title for work you have already been doing, or stop adding disclaimers before anyone has challenged you. Recognition can make it easier to step forward, but it becomes limiting when the response starts deciding how you dress, introduce yourself, or describe what you do. If an old label keeps introducing a version of you that no longer exists, replace it. You are not a product. Now choose yourself.

rows.body_you: You may care more about what you earn, what you charge, and what your money lets you say yes or no to. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation, making pay, spending, and what you can afford to choose feel more personal than usual. You may ask for a higher rate, spend on a visible upgrade, cover the bill, or compare your numbers with someone who seems to be earning more. Leo can make money feel like proof of value. A slow month is a financial fact, not a verdict on your worth. Ask for the rate that matches the work. If you buy something for pleasure, let pleasure be the reason.

rows.body_you: You may notice yourself wanting to put your name directly on the work, ideas, and messages you share right now. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 3rd house of communication and daily reality, bringing more attention to your voice, your writing, and the conversations that shape your day. You may send the message you kept revising, speak earlier in the meeting, publish an idea, or correct someone who repeats your point without crediting you. Wanting a warm reply is natural. The more you write for the reply, the easier it is to lose what you meant to say. Say what you mean plainly, and let the reply be what it is.

rows.body_you: You may want to change the room you live in, the family routine you keep, or the way your home is used. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 4th house of home and family, making you more aware of where your home reflects your taste and where family routines still belong to an older version of your life. You may move furniture, repair what has been broken, finally hang the art or photos that have been sitting in a box, invite people over, or stop following a family habit that no longer works for your life. Leo wants to feel proud of its surroundings, but a home can look impressive and still be uncomfortable to live in. Fix what affects your actual day before you decorate for an audience. Make the room work for the life you have now.

rows.body_you: You may want more time for the project, hobby, date, or afternoon you enjoy without needing a practical reason. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 5th house of fun and creativity, putting more attention on making, flirting, playing, taking creative risks, and enjoying your own life. You may restart a project you love, share work you are proud of, make plans because they sound fun, or take time off before every obligation is finished. The response can become a problem when you start choosing what to make based on what got the most attention last time. Start with what you want to make, then decide if you want to share it. Not for likes. Not for approval. For you.

rows.body_you: You may care more about how your workday runs and how your body feels at the end of it. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 6th house of daily routines and health, so the work, habits, and physical care that keep your day running may feel more personal than usual. You may reorganize your calendar, book the appointment, change a sleep or exercise routine, or take more pride in work nobody notices. You may mind the extra work more when nobody acknowledges it, or lose interest in a routine once the visible progress slows down. Most routines still have to work on the days nobody compliments you. Improve the part of the day that drains you most, and measure the change by what it gives back to your time or your body.

rows.body_you: You may want clearer proof that a one-on-one relationship matters to both of you. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 7th house of one-on-one bonds, making you more aware of how another person includes you in their plans, acknowledges your effort, and shows that you matter to them. You may want the plan confirmed, the introduction made warmly, your effort acknowledged, or the compliment said instead of assumed. A missed compliment, vague plan, or quiet response may carry more weight than it normally would. Wanting appreciation is reasonable. Expecting someone to guess the exact form you need is where resentment starts. Say what would make you feel appreciated, plainly. Then notice what they have been asking for too.

rows.body_you: You may be more willing to talk about money owed, responsibilities that need dividing, or help you have been reluctant to ask for. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 8th house of intimacy and energetic exchange, making questions about who owes what, who has access, and who carries which responsibility feel more personal. You may review a shared account, ask someone else to take on more of the shared workload, clarify what stays private, or admit that you need help with something you have been managing alone. It may be easier to insist you can handle it than to admit the bill, workload, or obligation needs to be shared. Name the amount, the task, or the help you are asking for.

rows.body_you: You may want to book the trip, take the class, publish the essay, or say the opinion you have been keeping for safer company. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 9th house of belief and adventure, bringing more confidence to what you know, what you want to learn, and how far you are willing to take an idea. You may enroll, teach, travel, submit your work, or become more outspoken about a belief that matters to you. The more publicly you defend an idea, the harder it can be to revise it when new information arrives. Being certain is not the same as being accurate. Share what you know, and leave enough room for new information to change the conclusion.

rows.body_you: You may care more about being recognized for the work you are actually doing this season. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 10th house of career and public life, putting more light on the work you want to be known for and making credit feel more personal. You may want to lead the project, put your name on the work, ask about the title, or notice more quickly when your contribution goes unacknowledged. Recognition matters, especially when the responsibility is already yours. Praise is useful. It cannot be the only measure of progress. Ask for the credit that matches the responsibility you already carry. Then keep building the work you want your name attached to.

rows.body_you: You may notice more clearly who includes you, who relies on you, and what role you keep playing in a group. The Sun in Leo is moving through your 11th house of friendships and community, making your role in groups easier to see and making appreciation from friends matter more than usual. You may be asked to organize, introduce someone, lead a project, celebrate a friend, or show up more publicly for a group you care about. Leo likes recognition, and group life gives you plenty of ways to count who replied, who came, and who thanked you. A friendship is not a scoreboard. Give recognition where it is deserved, and pay attention to the relationships where effort and appreciation move both ways.

rows.body_you: You may want fewer plans, less attention, and more uninterrupted time to sleep, finish private work, or step away from a role that is ending. The Sun in Leo usually wants to participate, create, and be recognized, but moving through your 12th house of endings and closure turns that attention toward rest, private work, and endings you do not need to announce. You may cancel a social plan, work without posting about it, need more sleep, finish a project you do not plan to share yet, or let a commitment end without a public explanation. A project finished quietly can feel less important when nobody sees it, and a day spent resting can feel like a day you have nothing to show for. The sleep still helps. The work still gets finished. The ending is still real. Finish what needs finishing, protect the time you need, and let one ending stay private.
